composition_subtypes.role: Compute shortest distances from a, b, c via BFS
Sort prices and use prefix sums to assign smallest prices to most traversed edges

payload.core_composition_summary: BFS computes shortest distances from a, b, c; then for each vertex as meeting point, assign smallest prices to b–meeting edges (used twice) and next smallest to a–meeting and c–meeting edges (used once) via sorted-price prefix sums.
payload.rationale: The solution combines BFS shortest paths and greedy assignment via sorted prices. It enumerates all vertices as junction points to find the minimal cost, leveraging prefix sums for efficient calculation.
